'''Copy and paste the following code into the "Summary" field below and fill in the correct information to properly source your image:'''
<pre>{{Image
| License                 = OPTIONS : Creative Commons, GFDL, Public Domain, Public Domain Self, Fairuse 
| ImageType1              = OPTIONS : Character, Chapter Art, Fan Art, Item, Map, Miscellaneous, Movie Posters, Movie Screenshots, 
                                      User, Logo, Video Game Screenshots, CCG
| ImageType2              = SAME AS IMAGETYPE1 (NOT REQUIRED)
| ImageType3              = SAME AS IMAGETYPE1 (NOT REQUIRED)
| Description             = BRIEF DESCRIPTION / SUMMARY OF IMAGE

| Source                  = SOURCE WHERE IMAGE WAS OBTAINED. (EITHER OFFLINE OR ONLINE)
| Artist                  = NAME OF ARTIST (LEAVE "Artist =" IN TEMPLATE IF NO ARTIST IS KNOWN)
}}</pre>
